guides.conceptEn: Strut preload, thermal axial force and staged unloading. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：深開挖內支撐預壓
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Preloading of deep-excavation struts
guides.concept: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。
guides.conceptEn: Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. The course separates preload targets, axial stiffness, temperature, seating and lock-off loss, then links strut interaction, second-order effects and unloading movement to common design and measurement baselines.
procedure: 支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。預壓可提早建立傳力路徑，但過高預壓會推動壁體或增加圍檁負擔；目標應由整體開挖變形與構件能力共同決定。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。
鋼支撐的軸向剛度由材料模數、截面積及有效長度決定，長支撐即使強度足夠也可能有較大縮短。真實系統還包括接頭及壁體柔度，串聯柔度會降低整體剛度；用單根鋼管剛度代表完整支撐線可能低估開挖位移。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。
鋼支撐受日照或施工環境變化而伸縮，若兩端受到限制，熱變形會轉成附加軸力。完全拘束給出上限尺度，但壁體與接頭柔度會釋放部分熱應變；監測若未扣除溫度，可能把可逆熱力誤判為土壓需求突然增加。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。
支撐軸力須經座板、加勁肋及圍檁傳到擋土壁，局部接觸面常比構件截面更容易控制。座板翹曲或墊塊不平會縮小有效面積並增加偏心；平均承壓只有在接觸分布合理時才能用來描述局部需求。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。
預壓由液壓設備轉移至機械鎖定後，楔塊坐入、墊片壓縮及接頭滑移會造成軸力損失。鎖定前讀值不是長期保留力，且溫度變化也會干擾比較；設計上需區分施加力、移交力與後續開挖引起的力增量。比例只描述這次力轉移，不是通用允許損失；應排除溫度及儀器漂移，並確認比較期間沒有其他支撐同步受力。
預壓一支支撐會推動圍檁與壁體，改變鄰近支撐的長度及軸力，因此各支撐並非互相獨立。施加順序及剛度差異決定反力分配，局部達到目標力可能同時使另一支卸載；整體平衡要以同一時間的力值判定。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。
受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。支撐的穩定檢查因此不能只看平均軸應力，還要核對接頭對心、側向約束與實際彎曲方向；局部改動可使整個支撐線更敏感。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。
千斤頂壓力乘有效活塞面積可估施力，但回油側壓力、摩擦及校正誤差會使真實力偏離理想值。壓力表量到的是液壓系統狀態，不能獨立證明支撐已受力；應與載重計或構件應變以及位移同步比對。理想公式假設差壓已扣除回壓且忽略摩擦，不是張拉操作程序；現場施力與停留點必須依核定設備和臨時工程方案。
開挖壁移除了累積量，變化速率及與支撐受力的相位也能協助診斷。位移持續加速可能代表支承尚未形成、土體潛變或地下水變化；短時間跳點則需先排除測量基準或儀器問題，不能把所有異常都歸因於地層失穩。兩點平均速率不能顯示期間加速或峰值，也不是通用停工值；需依資產敏感度與施工反應時間訂定判據。
永久樓板或其他支承接管荷載後，內支撐卸載會釋放儲存彈性能，使壁體及連接產生回彈。回彈方向與既有塑性變形不一定相同，不能假設解除預壓就回到施工前的位置；卸載分析需包含替代支承剛度與接觸狀態。回彈估算假設線性卸載且接觸不變，未含塑性、摩擦與土體時效；不能把四毫米直接當許可的卸載變位。
procedureEn: Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone. Preload can establish the load path early, but excessive preload pushes the wall or overloads walers. The target must therefore follow overall excavation deformation and member resistance rather than a desire to maximize initial force. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.

Axial stiffness depends on modulus, area and length, so a long strut can shorten substantially despite adequate strength. The system also includes splice and wall flexibility; serial compliances reduce overall stiffness. Using the steel member alone to represent the entire support line can therefore underestimate excavation movement and misrepresent load sharing. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.

Struts expand and contract with sunlight and construction conditions, generating axial force when restrained. Full restraint gives a bounding scale, while wall and connection flexibility release part of the thermal strain. Without temperature correction, monitoring may misinterpret reversible thermal force as a sudden increase in earth-pressure demand. The fully restrained expression is not a direct site prediction; serial stiffness determines release, and solar gradients can induce bending as well as uniform axial force.

Strut force passes through seats, stiffeners and walers into the wall, and local contact may govern before the member section. Warped plates or uneven packing reduce effective area and increase eccentricity. Mean bearing pressure describes local demand only where the assumed contact distribution is credible. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area.

Transferring preload from hydraulics to mechanical locking can lose force through wedge seating, packing compression and splice slip. The pre-lock reading is not retained force, and temperature changes complicate comparison. Design must distinguish applied force, transferred force and increments caused by subsequent excavation. The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison.

Preloading one strut moves the waler and wall, changing neighbouring lengths and forces. Supports are therefore coupled through stiffness and sequence. Achieving a local target may unload another strut, so overall equilibrium must use simultaneous readings rather than peaks recorded at different times. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body.

Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. Stability checks therefore require alignment, lateral restraint and actual bending direction as well as average axial stress. Local modifications can increase sensitivity of the entire support line. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity.

Pressure times effective piston area estimates jack force, but return pressure, friction and calibration error alter actual output. A pressure gauge measures the hydraulic system rather than independently proving force in the strut. Compare it with a load cell or member strain and with displacement on a synchronized time base. The ideal equation assumes backpressure is already removed and neglects friction; it is not an operating procedure, and force application follows approved equipment and temporary-works plans.

Cumulative wall movement, rate and timing relative to strut force all aid diagnosis. Sustained acceleration may indicate incomplete restraint, soil creep or groundwater changes, whereas a sudden isolated jump first requires checks of datum and instrument integrity. Not every anomalous reading establishes ground instability, but trends must not be dismissed without evidence. A two-point mean rate hides intermediate acceleration and peaks and is not a universal stop value; criteria depend on asset sensitivity and response time.

When permanent slabs or other restraints take over, strut unloading releases stored elastic energy and causes wall and connection rebound. The rebound need not reverse accumulated plastic deformation or restore the original position. Analysis must include replacement-support stiffness and contact state rather than treating preload removal as a simple return to zero. The rebound estimate assumes linear unloading and unchanged contact, excluding plasticity, friction and time effects; four millimetres is not an authorized unloading movement.
evidence: 預壓驗收應同時保留力與位移曲線；接觸異常由臨時工程設計者核定修正，不以反覆加壓取代診斷。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。
分析模型應明列鋼材、接頭、圍檁與壁體柔度；變更接頭型式前由結構設計者重新核對整體剛度。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。
軸力警戒應注明溫度基準與修正方式；設計者審核總力及去溫度趨勢，兩者都不可省略。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。
預壓前必須驗收接觸及加勁細部；座板變形異常由連接設計者評估，不能只換更大的千斤頂。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。
驗收文件需列施加、鎖定及穩定後力值；超出核定損失範圍時由設計者查明原因後決定是否調整。比例只描述這次力轉移，不是通用允許損失；應排除溫度及儀器漂移，並確認比較期間沒有其他支撐同步受力。
evidenceEn: Preload acceptance retains force and displacement curves; the temporary-works designer approves seating corrections rather than replacing diagnosis with repeated pressurization. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.

Identify steel, splice, waler and wall compliance in analysis; the structural designer reassesses system stiffness before a connection type changes. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.

Force triggers state temperature reference and correction method; the designer reviews both total force and temperature-corrected trend, retaining neither as a substitute for the other. The fully restrained expression is not a direct site prediction; serial stiffness determines release, and solar gradients can induce bending as well as uniform axial force.

Accept contact and stiffening before preload; the connection designer investigates seat deformation rather than responding with a larger jack. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area.

Acceptance records include applied, locked and stabilized forces; losses outside approved bounds require designer diagnosis before adjustment is decided. The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison.
pitfalls: 接觸未建立就讀取千斤頂壓力，可能誤判預壓已傳入支撐，卸壓後壁體仍有自由移動空間。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。
忽略熱力可能誤觸發警報，也可能在最高溫時低估支撐總軸力與挫屈需求。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。
只記施加峰值會高估保留預壓，後續開挖時壁體可能先移動才重新接觸支撐。比例只描述這次力轉移，不是通用允許損失；應排除溫度及儀器漂移，並確認比較期間沒有其他支撐同步受力。
小偏心在高軸力下可形成顯著彎矩，局部側向支承失效會進一步放大變形並降低穩定餘裕。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。
只設總位移警報可能錯過快速惡化，過度平滑資料又會掩蓋施工事件造成的短時加速。兩點平均速率不能顯示期間加速或峰值，也不是通用停工值；需依資產敏感度與施工反應時間訂定判據。
pitfallsEn: Reading jack pressure before contact is established can falsely indicate transferred preload while the wall retains free movement after unloading. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.

Ignoring thermal force can cause false alarms or underestimate total axial and buckling demand at the highest temperature. The fully restrained expression is not a direct site prediction; serial stiffness determines release, and solar gradients can induce bending as well as uniform axial force.

Recording only the applied peak overstates retained preload, allowing the wall to move before restraint fully re-engages during excavation. The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison.

Small eccentricity under high compression produces significant bending; lost lateral support further magnifies deformation and reduces stability margin. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity.

A cumulative-only trigger can miss rapid deterioration, while excessive smoothing conceals short-term acceleration associated with construction events. A two-point mean rate hides intermediate acceleration and peaks and is not a universal stop value; criteria depend on asset sensitivity and response time.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 深開挖內支撐預壓
history.text: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1999年：美國聯邦公路管理局發布地錨及錨定系統指南，包含試驗與防蝕背景；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. The course separates preload targets, axial stiffness, temperature, seating and lock-off loss, then links strut interaction, second-order effects and unloading movement to common design and measurement baselines. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1999: FHWA publishes the ground-anchor guide including testing and corrosion-protection context; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
